$comment: What each video codes in (v1.5): concept | cpp | java | python | js. `npm run tag:videos` (scripts/tag-videos.mjs) writes `codeLang` (and `alsoCodeLang` when a title names more than one language) onto every video in src/data/resources.json and src/data/path/beginner-path.json from this table (and, v1.6, `npm run fill:playlists` onto every playlist in src/data/playlists.json, a walkthroughs playlist counting as a walkthrough); `npm run check:links` fails when a video's tag is missing, unknown or out of date, or its channel isn't listed here. Order of the rules: an override for the video id, then languages named in the title (the first one named is the tag, the rest go in alsoCodeLang), then the channel's rule. A channel's `codes` applies to every video (`when: always`) or only to walkthroughs (`when: walkthrough`: listed as a walkthrough in resources.json, or a title naming a LeetCode problem). Unsure means concept: a channel is only given a language when it codes on screen in that one language.
